resources.string: Free website blocker for focus. No account, no ads, no tracking — everything stays on your device.
Protection is OFF. Turn on the switch to block your list.
No sites blocked yet. Add your first distraction above.

How it works: FocusBlock runs a local VPN that only intercepts DNS lookups for your blocked sites and answers "this site does not exist". No data ever leaves your device and other apps keep working normally. Browsers show a "site can\'t be reached" error for blocked sites. For strict blocking, also turn off "Private DNS" in Android settings and any "Secure DNS" option in your browser.
